wrong.why: The Hebrew names Jashobeam, not Josheb-basshebeth, as Zabdiel's son.
The person described as being among Perez's descendants is the first month's chief, Jashobeam, rather than his father Zabdiel.
The verse identifies Eliezer son of Zichri as ruler for the Reubenites without stating Zichri's ancestry.
The verse identifies Hashabiah son of Kemuel as the official for Levi without stating Kemuel's ancestry.
Omri's father is the Michael distinguished as his father, not Michael son of Izrahiah.
The verse calls Omri son of Michael, matching the record for Michael father of Omri.
The verse names Jerimoth son of Azriel as the official for Naphtali without stating Azriel's ancestry.
The verse names Ishmaiah son of Obadiah as the official for Zebulun without stating Obadiah's ancestry.
The verse names Hoshea son of Azaziah as the official for Ephraim's children without stating Azaziah's ancestry.
The verse names Joel son of Pedaiah as the official for half the tribe of Manasseh without stating Pedaiah's ancestry.
The verse names Iddo son of Zechariah as the official for Manasseh in Gilead without stating Zechariah's ancestry.
The verse names Azarel son of Jeroham as the official for Dan without stating Jeroham's ancestry.
Azmaveth's father is the Adiel distinguished as his father, not Adiel son of Jahzerah.
The verse calls the treasurer Azmaveth son of Adiel, matching Adiel father of David's treasurer.
Jehonathan's father is the Uzziah distinguished as father of the storehouse overseer.
The verse names Jehonathan's father Uzziah without identifying him as Uzziah son of Uriel.
